answer: By the marble of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, expired if not renewed by fresh work. A anchor of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ripple of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it.
